prompt:
Create a SIX-PHASE EAST WALK atlas of this EXACT Doguri model. Reference1 is the definitive corrected TRUE RIGHT SIDE camera and original short leg articulation. Preserve its one visible white eye ring, profile burgundy mask and white snout pointing RIGHT, pink round head/ears, red apple/green leaf attached on top, short plump pink torso and SHORT pink knee/legs with dark burgundy paws, small pink mitten arms, attached purple-grey/white striped tail with green tip behind LEFT. Reference2 preserves original identity. Same original head/body/tail ratio; no redesign, human legs, armor, new species or 3D model/render. Painted2D game sprite as in reference1.
Transparent portrait1024x1536. EXACT ONE COLUMN and SIX ROWS,6full bodies total, SAME RIGHT side view in every row, no front/3quarter view and no direction turns. Whole apple-to-paw/tail figure occupies at most60% of each256px-high row, with at least50px empty transparent gap between complete bodies; wide side/top/bottom margins. Keep the last row complete and away from bottom edge. No captions/grid.
Real six-phase grounded walking, change full attached SHORT leg chains and counter-swing arms/tail, not copies with vertical shifts. All thighs/knees/paws remain visible below belly, never disappear:
Row1 CONTACT-A: NEAR larger foreground paw leads RIGHT heel first, FAR smaller paw trails LEFT on toe. Near short thigh crosses in FRONT at hip. Near arm back LEFT, far arm forward RIGHT.

Row3 PASS-A: near leg planted vertically below belly, FAR knee and complete far paw swing forward RIGHT, far paw one paw-height above floor, far upper thigh BEHIND near thigh at overlap. Near arm begins forward. Two full leg chains; only near paw grounded.
Row4 CONTACT-B: FAR smaller paw lands forward RIGHT, NEAR larger foreground paw trails LEFT on toe. Reverse the two actual hip-knee-paw chains from row1 and keep near leg's foreground overlap on LEFT. Near arm forward RIGHT, far arm back LEFT.
Row5 DOWN-B: FAR front-right knee flexes with far sole planted, near rear-left heel rises for toe-off, weight loads over far support. Near leg slightly thicker in foreground behind LEFT.
Row6 PASS-B: exactly the key leg configuration of reference1: FAR leg vertical supporting below belly, NEAR short pink thigh/bent knee and dark paw advance RIGHT in foreground, NEAR paw clearly one paw-height above floor. Near thigh crosses IN FRONT. Near arm back LEFT, far arm forward RIGHT. Next pose loops to near contact row1.
Keep both connected hip-thigh-knee-shin-paw chains and exact small-animal squat proportions, no exaggerated kick/jump or whole-body bounce substitute. Subtle continuous tail follow-through, apple attached/stable, same mask/eye and garment-free body. No shadow/ground, halo, fog, particles, detached leaves, extra appendages, red outline noise, text or opaque background. Six well-separated clean-alpha complete sprites.
